versions.changelog:
dlazy-gemini-2-5-tts v1.3.3

- Upgraded CLI dependency to @dlazy/cli@1.2.3 in install instructions and metadata.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md to reference the new CLI version.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Updated CLI install instructions and metadata to use @dlazy/cli version 1.2.2 (was 1.2.0).
- npm global and npx install commands now reference the latest supported CLI version.
- Skill version updated from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Documentation in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md revised to match version and install changes.

- Removed the skill-card.md file from the repository.
- No changes to functionality or user experience.
set Chinese display name for CN search

dlazy-gemini-2-5-tts v1.3.0 changelog

- Version bump from 1.2.1 to 1.3.0.
- Documentation updated (SKILL.md, SKILL-cn.md); no changes to functionality or CLI usage.

dlazy-gemini-2-5-tts v1.2.1

- Added Chinese to the skill description for improved bilingual support.
- Documentation files SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md updated.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.

- Updated CLI dependency to @dlazy/cli@1.2.0 (was 1.0.9).
- Adjusted install and usage instructions to use the new pinned CLI version.
- Updated the output format example to reflect changes in modelId.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

dlazy-gemini-2-5-tts v1.1.1

- Updated SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md documentation.
- Bumped version number from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1.

Version 1.1.0

- Added recommended authentication via device-code flow (`dlazy login`) for easier setup.
- Updated authentication instructions to prioritize device-code flow and clarified manual key configuration as an alternative.
- No changes to CLI usage or functionality; documentation improvements only.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Minor update to skill version 1.0.3.
- Clarified agent instructions for handling missing or invalid API keys: the user should be told to provide the key and the agent should save it, instead of asking the user to send it and then save it.
- No changes to core functionality or command options.

- Updated CLI dependency to @dlazy/cli version 1.0.6 (was 1.0.5).
- No feature or behavior changes; documentation updated to reflect CLI version change.

- Added an explicit Authentication section with instructions to set and obtain the dLazy API key.
- Clarified that all requests require API key configuration via CLI.
- No changes to usage, options, output, or error handling.

Initial release of dlazy-gemini-2.5-tts.

- Generate multilingual, highly natural audio from text using Gemini 2.5 TTS.
- Supports command-line options for language, voice, and prompt customization.
- Handles errors such as missing API key, insufficient balance, and server failures with user guidance.
- Provides example commands and detailed usage instructions.
- Clear instructions for resolving authorization and credit issues.
